answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, reset on any identity-link attempt, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The tide is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the garden. The onyx of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
